g.text: Floorplan B rev 1 on the real GF180 1x1 tile (die 346.64 x 160.72 um, 39 rows, taps and endcaps from the h2 DEF in dark grey, TT pins on the top edge; used pins red).
Packing = (expected cells + taps inside) / region area; expected cells = in-context synthesized area + h2 PnR reserve (upsizing, repair buffers, CTS share).
Unassigned placeable area 0 um2; dashed = soft sub-regions inside the datapath cluster.
